conversationalSummary.text: TODAY there’s no really reliable window, and wind looks like the main problem with gusts making things feel messy—especially for the bay setups. Meio da Baia is the least-bad option after work, but it may end up a bit too soft without more push, and confidence is low. I’d check Surfline (and MEO Beachcam for your preferred spots) before leaving, and only head out if the cams look much cleaner than expected; otherwise I’d save the drive.

best.explanation: Meio da Baia looks like a fun-sized window for Worth checking, Low confidence: 0.6-0.9 m, 66 kJ, 8 s period, consistent 76/100, and wind is the main risk.  An inconsistent Baía spot that can work well when north-northwest swell reaches the bay; this is best for bodyboard sessions when the bay is clean, there is enough period and size, and the forecast shows a defined wave; 6-9s at mid tide can make exposed beaches like Belgas / Almagreira / Cerro / Meio da Baia sharp and rippable.  Watch: wind angle is poor for this spot; Meio da Baia may feel too soft without more push; gusts over 35 km/h could make it messy.
best.shortExplanation: Meio da Baia is worth a quick check for after work (16:30 start), but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  Wind is the main thing to watch.  The tide and timing are lining up well for this spot.
